name: Area icon
description: Passive icon: a bright inner circle and a fainter outer one — reach spreading outward. Port of the hand-drawn i_area from Feelers' BootScene. Rim is `$pink`, the same as `ss.icon.mine`: this passive is the Spore evolution's other half, so the pair reads as a pair on the bar. The glyph wears the rim's colour as well, so the passive is one colour on the bar.
